title: Waaqeffattoota Waadaa Galan
intro: Raajiin kabajamaan tokko gara dhugaatti isaan waamuun namoota gidduu deddeebi’e. Baay’een isaanii mata jabinaan garagalanii kan turan yoo ta’u, geengoon xiqqaan of kenne tokko waamicha deebisee garaa guutuudhaan waadaa seene. Shakkiin qoramanii rizqii samii barbaaduuf ija jabaatan. Of kennuu isaanii kan hin raafamne amantii irratti barumsa yeroo hin qabne ta’e. Eenyu turan?
clues: Nuti garee xiqqaa yeroo kufrii bal’inaan itti mul’atutti ergama waaqummaa deggeruuf kaane turre.
Nabiyyiin kabajamaan tokko dhufee karaa Rabbii irratti michuu taanee akka dhaabbannu nu waame.
Raajichi eenyutu deeggartoota Waaqummaa ta’a yeroo gaafatu, osoo hin shakkiin deebisne.
Ayyaana dinqii samii irraa gadi bu’ee garaa keenya jabeessuuf gaafachuuf ija jabaannee.
Nabiyyiin keenya amantoota dhugaa taanaan Rabbiin akka kabajnu nu yaadachiise, ammas gaaffiin keenya gad of deebisuu kabajame.
Nuti geengoo keessaa of kennanii fi Isaa ilma Maariyaam cinatti amantii hin sochoone waadaa galle turre.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
